newsitem.title: TANZANIA: British aid to support Tanzania's economic reforms.
newsitem.headline: British aid to support Tanzania's economic reforms.

text.p: Britain has approved a 25 million sterling ($41 million) grant to support Tanzania's economic reforms and the laying-off of redundant civil servants, a government statement said on Sunday.
The statement said the aid was agreed in talks between Tanzanian President Benjamin Mkapa and British Overseas Development Minister Lynda Chalker in London earlier this month.
It follows the recent resumption of aid from the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and the signing of an enhanced structural adjustment facility (ESAF) to support the government's economic reforms.
Banking sources in Dar es Salaam said the IMF agreement had opened the way for further aid from western donors.

Speaking to local editors in Dar es Salaam last week, Mkapa said his government would continue with its efforts to improve the economy. It was hoped to reduce inflation from 18 to 15 per cent by next June.
